successors.name: Ashanti Empire
successors.text: the Denkyira kingdom, 'reduced to a tributary of the newly ascendant Asante Empire' after Feyiase (August 1701)

ledger.x: 1650s: Boamponsem makes Denkyira the great power of the Ofin-Pra basin.

wars.name: Denkyira-Agona conflict with Akwamu
wars.outcome: 'In 1688 it supported Agona in a conflict with Akwamu, and later attempted to invade Fetu'; no outcome and no land on the page (Akwamu's last major campaign against Agona was in 1689).

wars.name: Denkyira conquest of Assin
wars.outcome: Denkyira conquered Assin, destroying its towns and markets and imposing heavy tribute.

wars.name: Battle of Feyiase
wars.outcome: Asante victory in August 1701: Ntim Gyakari killed, Denkyira's hegemony broken and the kingdom reduced to a tributary of Asante; Denkyira's army had two or three Dutch cannons, taken by the Asante.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier; the shape is a circle and a town standing for the Ofin-Pra basin and Assin.
